name: Seychelles
summary: Seychelles levies personal income tax on employment emoluments and business tax on business income; there is no capital gains tax, and foreign-source dividends and investment income of a private individual are not taxed (territorial system). No wealth, inheritance or gift tax; foreigners owning residential property pay an annual immovable property tax of 0.25% of market value. Residence for foreigners needs a permit. Low-to-medium confidence: no Big-4 summary was available.

regimes.name: Seychelles residence
regimes.description: Territorial: no CGT; foreign dividends untaxed; no wealth or inheritance tax.

capital_gains.summary: Capital gains are not subject to tax in Seychelles (Lloyds Bank Trade). Business tax applies only to Seychelles-sourced business income (territorial since 2019, Business Tax Act 2009 as amended).

sources.title: Seychelles Revenue Commission: Domestic taxation (Income and Non-Monetary Benefits Tax)

open_questions: The Business Tax Act text was not read; gains that form part of a business (trading) could be business income.
capital_gains.professional_trader: Gains of a business (trading) could fall under business tax; private investors not affected.

dividends.summary: Individuals' income tax is levied on employment emoluments (SRC). Foreign dividends of a private individual are not taxed. Seychelles-company dividends: 15% WHT to non-residents; 0% between resident entities.

sources.title: Seychelles Revenue Commission: Domestic taxation (Income and Non-Monetary Benefits Tax)

open_questions: Whether a resident individual receiving dividends from a Seychelles company suffers 15% WHT was not verified.
dividends.rate_basis: Foreign dividends 0 (outside both the employment-income tax and Seychelles-source business tax). Domestic rate unknown (null).
dividends.withholding_outbound: 15% WHT on dividends, interest and royalties paid to non-residents; 0% between resident entities (Lloyds).
dividends.treaty_network: Treaty network size not verified; no treaty with the United States.

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Foreigners who own residential immovable property pay an annual immovable property tax of 0.25% of market value (Lloyds). Stamp duty 5% on purchases by residents; special rules for non-residents. Not a wealth tax.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax was found.

sources.title: Seychelles Revenue Commission: Domestic taxation (Income and Non-Monetary Benefits Tax)

open_questions: Stamp duty on transfers of immovable property on death or by gift not verified.
inheritance.foreign_assets: No tax found on any asset.

residency.tax_residency_test: Generally resident if present 183+ days in a year (not verified against the statute).

routes.name: Residence permit / Gainful Occupation Permit
routes.requirements: Foreigners need a residence permit (e.g. for retirees, investors or dependants) or a Gainful Occupation Permit; foreign purchase of property requires government sanction. Terms not verified.

corporate.summary: Business tax 25% on the first SCR 1M of taxable income and 33% above (Uniwide, 2019 figures; not verified for 2026). Companies with economic substance can be exempt on foreign passive income.

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain US-taxed; no US-Seychelles tax treaty.
